production.note: US model years 2020-2022. First: 'The all-new 2020 Mustang Shelby GT500'. Last: Cars.com lists a 2022 Shelby GT500 (cars-com-2022-gt500), and Ford Authority says of the 2023 Mustang that the Shelby GT500 was discontinued, removing the 5.2L Predator engine from the lineup (fordauthority-mustang-2023).

displacementL.note: '5.2L'. 5,163 cc: Car and Driver's panel prints "315 in3, 5163 cm3" (cd-shelby-gt500-2020); Cars.com lists '5.2 L/315' (cars-com-2020-gt500).

aspiration.note: 'supercharged 5.2L Predator V8'; Motor Authority: 'a 2.65-liter Eaton blower'.

drivetrain.note: 'The power is then routed to the rear wheels via a Tremec 7-speed dual-clutch transmission'

powerHp.note: Ford press release (19 June 2019) reproduced by Motor1. Quote: "The all-new 2020 Mustang Shelby GT500 will produce 760 horsepower and 625 lb.-ft. of torque, making it the most powerful street-legal Ford ever". Cars.com gives '760 @ 7300' for 2020 and 2022. Car and Driver's road-test panel agrees: "Power" / "760 hp @ 7300 rpm" (cd-shelby-gt500-2020).

weightLb.note: Weight-order step 2: Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision, 9 October 2026, docs/DATA_GUIDE.md); a measured weight of C/D's test car. Car and Driver road-test panel '2020 Ford Mustang Shelby GT500' (owner copy), quote: "Curb weight: 4171 lb". Test car: "front-engine, rear-wheel-drive, 4-passenger, 2-door coupe", "7-speed dual-clutch automatic" (the only transmission), "$81,565 (base price: $74,095)" as tested; options are not listed. The earlier provisional figure, 4,225 lb (a leaked Ford dealer training manual reported by Motor Authority and Ford Authority), is 1.3% higher; Cars.com lists 4,183 lb. See discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Car and Driver's figure is the measured weight of its test car; 4,225 lb is from a leaked Ford dealer training manual (Motor Authority, Ford Authority), not confirmed by Ford; 4,183 lb is the Cars.com database figure. They span 1.3%.
discrepancies.resolution: Owner decision, 9 October 2026: the Car and Driver road-test curb weight is used (docs/DATA_GUIDE.md, Weight step 2). 4,171 lb used; the earlier 4,225 lb was the provisional figure.
